title: Digital Overload
description: A surreal painting of a blue-skinned woman with flowing hair made of swirling numbers, flowers, and floating smartphones. In the background, three humanoid figures with tablet screens for heads sit at a wooden desk displaying text about job loss and AI, while another silhouette appears on the wall.
prompt: Surreal painting of a blue-skinned woman with an open mouth and intense expression, her hair composed of swirling numbers, dried flowers, and floating smartphones. In the midground, three grotesque humanoid figures with tablet screens for heads sit at a wooden desk, the screens displaying text about AI taking jobs. A ghostly human silhouette is drawn on the smoky background wall. Numbers and petals float through the air, dark moody atmosphere with visible brushwork.
